column1: # unisacc kernel assembly byte oracle, A64 (spec §4.8 AS-5, AS-7). Hand-derived from the Arm
# Architecture Reference Manual for A-profile (Arm ARM, DDI 0487), section C6.2 "Alphabetical
# list of A64 base instructions" (cited by instruction page name, not by subsection number,
# which differs between issues), and the AS rules; never copied from product output. Same
# columns as x86_64.tsv. Words are the four little-endian bytes of the 32-bit instruction
# (AS-5.1). Field notation: sf, Rd/Rn/Rm/Ra/Rt, imm12/imm16/imm19/imm26, hw, N:immr:imms.
# Correction log: a-tbnz-x and a-tbz-x were first derived with imm14=-1 mis-added into [23:19];
# re-derived field by field (b40=1 at [23:19], imm14=0x3FFF at [18:5]) on 2026-10-27.

column10: C6.2 ADD (immediate) imm12 left zero; AS-7 R_AARCH64_ADD_ABS_LO12_NC .data addend 8
C6.2 ADD (shifted register) shift=LSL imm6=5 at [15:10]
C6.2 ADRP 0x90000000|Rd, immhi:immlo zero; AS-7 R_AARCH64_ADR_PREL_PG_HI21
C6.2 AND (immediate) 0x92000000; N=1 immr=60 imms=59 (DecodeBitMasks shared pseudocode)
C6.2 B 0x14000000 imm26 zero; AS-7 R_AARCH64_JUMP26
C6.2 CMP (immediate) = SUBS WZR 0x7100001F; imm12=55 (AS-3 constant)
C6.2 LDR (immediate) 64-bit imm12 zero; AS-7 R_AARCH64_LDST64_ABS_LO12_NC .data addend 8
C6.2 MOV (inverted wide immediate) = MOVN 32-bit 0x12800000 hw=0 imm16=0 (AS-5.3 order)
AS-5.6 uxtw Xd,Wn = C6.2 UBFM Xd,Xn,#0,#31 0xD3407C00
AS-3 .word is 4 bytes on A64 (2 on x86-64)
AS-3 .p2align in data pads with zero bytes
AS-3 .p2align in A64 text pads with C6.2 NOP 0xD503201F
AS-7 CALL26 addend is the written addend
AS-7 relocation records in instruction order
AS-7 ADRP against an undefined symbol
AS-7 ADD_ABS_LO12_NC against an undefined symbol
AS-7 LDST64_ABS_LO12_NC addend = section offset + written addend
